title: Three rollout dials in internal/config have no production reader, and ParallelEvaluate's ladder disagrees with its docs
summary: Found by comment-reduction batch 6 (2026-09-26) and reported without changing code. RolloutStages.MergeGate, RolloutStages.ScoutDecompose and RoutingConfig.ScoutDecomposeConcurrency are parsed but nothing outside the package reads them, and policy.MergeGateConfig() has no production caller. This is dead config: a knob whose value never reaches a construction. Separately, ParallelEvaluate parses on the full off/shadow/advisory/enforce ladder, while the design docs describe off/shadow/enforce and TestParallelEvaluate_StageLadder never exercises advisory. ADR-0044 (around line 171) still describes the retired EVOLVE_PHASE_RECOVERY env dial.
fix: Delete the three dead dials and MergeGateConfig, or wire them to a real consumer with a wiring pin. Make ParallelEvaluate's accepted values match its docs, with a test for each accepted value. Correct the ADR-0044 paragraph.
acceptance: grep finds a production reader for every RolloutStages and RoutingConfig field that remains
ParallelEvaluate's accepted values equal its documented ladder, and a table test covers each one
ADR-0044 no longer describes EVOLVE_PHASE_RECOVERY as a live env dial
priority_rationale: inbox review 2026-09-27: Dead config and a doc mismatch; no runtime effect.
